flavor.phonemic_palette: Basque-Vasconian backbone (the Iberian substrate realized in Basque: tx/tz, h, rr, -a article, k/g; no native f) with a Frankish overlay (-burg/-mark, the feudal -o offices); theophoric on the Iberian morphs (Caiandos-, Orlanno-) with Frankish variants (Giando-, Erlant-).
flavor.phenotype_notes: Synthesis of Frankish + Iberian per setting-lore §5.3 (blend the listed features; exclude the inverse).

magic_attitude.notes: Frankish + Iberian register; deity-morphs in name_bank 'vascani'.

religion_hooks.alignment_lens: Resolved per the culture's chosen alignment (setting-lore §4.2): Lawful venerates the 12 Lawful powers and names the 13 as demons; Chaotic venerates the 13 and names the 12 as tyrant-gods; Neutral venerates this culture's ancestral saints, invoking the great gods only situationally.

flavor_text.one_line: Vascani — wary feudal of the hills; honor, freedom.
flavor_text.one_paragraph: The Vascani (Frankish + Iberian) are a assertive feudal people seeded in hills, mountains. They prize honor, freedom, piety, lean toward the military sphere, and field heavy_infantry, heavy_cavalry, light_infantry. Outsiders are met as wary; their patrons touch war, mountains, light.
